Marta: Minute check before GA push: are SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing FAQ all marked as non-blocking? Call out any true blockers now.
Devon: SLA done, docs PR in flight (docs#452). Need one lgtm.
Eli: Monitoring: added p95 and p99 panels. Missing one alert for sustained token cpu > 70% for 10m. I can add it now.
Priya: Support runbook has a gap: who calls customers for quota incidents? Sam volunteered earlier but not listed. @Marta can you confirm?
Marta: Sam is on the list. I'll update runbook and push.
Devon: Pricing FAQ: included burst vs reserved example and a short note on commit discounts. Posted in docs PR.
Eli: Added alert rule: token_cpu_utilization_p95 > 70% for 10m. Also created dashboard link: /console/dashboards/launch-health.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-21T22:45Z pending manual GO from Marta.
Marta: OK owners recap: Devon -> docs PR + pricing FAQ; Eli -> alerts + dashboard; Priya -> support runbook update with Sam's contact. If nothing blocks by 12:00 PT I give GO. Flag blockers here with :rotating_light:.
Devon: LGTM from docs team received.
Priya: Runbook updated and link posted.
Marta: Manual GO given. Proceed with canary once deploy-bot shows healthy. :white_check_mark:
